name: scanengine
description: LidarScan shared capture/SLAM engine (Tech Spec workstream A).
$dependency-onboarding-order: A1 (now): eigen3 only. The engine core is dependency-light on purpose — every added port must build on all five CI legs, including the macOS universal overlay triplet and the Android NDK triplet.

A7 / A10: gtsam (pose-graph optimization, georef fusion). BEFORE adding it, verify each required transitive Boost component's vcpkg portfile is CMake-based: autotools/configure ports cannot compile-and-run their configure checks for two architectures at once and therefore FAIL under cmake/triplets/universal-osx.cmake. See spikes/s7-windows-toolchain/TOOLCHAIN_NOTES.md.
A7 (optional): ceres-solver, if the LIO refinement wants it alongside GTSAM. Decide in A7.

A3: Livox SDK2 is NOT a vcpkg port. It stays VENDORED and PATCHED (pinned + 3 patches in spikes/s2-mid360-sim/patches/) because stock SDK2's broadcast bind fails with EADDRNOTAVAIL on macOS. Do not swap it for a port without re-running that bind test.
Renderer: Filament is fetched as a prebuilt release by the app layers (S3 pinned v1.75.0), never linked into libscanengine — the engine stays renderer-free and hands out point pages.
$baseline-note: builtin-baseline is pinned to the same microsoft/vcpkg commit as .github/workflows/engine-ci.yml's VCPKG_COMMIT. Bump both together, never one alone.
